summary: Configured Nginx on node1 to serve `/` successfully over TCP port 6700. The service, firewall rule, SELinux permission, and HTTP response persisted across a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Installed the signed Nginx 1.20.2 package compatible with RHEL 7.9.
Configured Nginx to listen on 0.0.0.0:6700 and serve a landing page at `/`.
Enabled the persistent firewalld rule and SELinux port mapping for TCP 6700.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its boot identity changed and service recovered.

evidence.requirement: Nginx serves a successful HTTP response at `/` on TCP port 6700
evidence.summary: Configuration validation succeeded; Nginx became active and enabled; port 6700 was listening and allowed through firewalld; direct access through node1's managed IP returned HTTP 200 with the expected page.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart and recovery sequence
evidence.summary: Healthy pre-restart boot ID and HTTP service were captured; reboot acknowledgement returned; boot ID changed from fe422859-bfe7-4eb4-819b-e09864f3ca60 to e269878e-9fc5-4d11-a552-d3c5b8d753e2; afterward Nginx was active and enabled, listening on port 6700, firewalld allowed the port, and `/` returned HTTP 200.
